predictive_services_discussion: Moderate to high-risk significant fire potential is forecast across the southern Plains and Southern Mississippi Valley today with highs reaching 100°F and locally breezy winds, extending over Oklahoma and Kansas amid RH of 25-30%. Moderate conditions continue across parts of Wyoming, eastern Montana, and northeast Colorado, due to continuing hot, dry, and breezy conditions, with temperatures reaching 90-100°F, RH lowering to 10-20%, and winds gusts of 20-35. Dry and breezy winds continue over parts of the Great Basin with low-risk conditions there. Across the remainder of the west, little to no risk of significant fire potential continues due to cooler conditions and recent rainfall across the northwest.
